thread.title: Five Miami divers qualify for NCAA Swimming and Diving Championships
thread.title_full: Five Miami divers qualify for NCAA Swimming and Diving Championships

author: m. s. goins
title: Five Miami divers qualify for NCAA Swimming and Diving Championships
text:
Five Miami Hurricanes divers qualified for the NCAA Swimming and Diving Championships following their performances at the Zone B qualifying event at Gabrielsen Natatorium, which concluded on March 11.
The qualification is significant as it allows these athletes to compete at the national level, representing Miami in both men’s and women’s events.
Chiara Pellacani and Margo O’Meara were among the top performers for Miami, each securing spots in both the 1-meter and 3-meter springboard events. On the men’s side, freshman Matteo Santoro and redshirt freshman Jake Passmore also qualified in both springboard events. Senior Mohamed Farouk earned his place in platform diving—where he previously received All-America honors—and will also compete in the 3-meter event.
Pellacani continued her strong postseason by finishing first in 1-meter qualifying with a score of 662.85 and second in the 3-meter with a score of 769.90. O’Meara finished seventh in the 3-meter (641.40) and fifth in her first year at Miami on the 1-meter (624.65).
For the men, Santoro placed second on the 1-meter springboard (778.15) and won top honors on the 3-meter with a score of 895.55. Passmore was sixth on the 1-meter (743.80) and secured a spot on the 3-meter by finishing tenth (782.75). Farouk placed second in platform qualifying with a score of 776.10, which also allowed him to qualify for the 3-meter after finishing twelfth.
The NCAA Women’s Swimming & Diving Championships will take place from March 18-21 at Georgia Tech’s McAuley Aquatic Center in Atlanta, followed by the men’s championships from March 25-28 at the same venue.
